tool_action.public_message: Cut to $200 for mortgaged Indiana and Illinois. You only owe the bank $23 to hold them mortgaged — unmortgage after the light blues. With Kentucky that's the red set for less than one Boardwalk house. I'm on Baltic: 11/36 I hit p4's 4-house blues ($400–$450) and can't cover it. If I bust, p4 inherits pinks, Tennessee (they complete orange), both reds, and a third railroad. $200 keeps a counterweight alive and gives you a second engine. Buffer stays ~$160 plus house equity.
tool_action.private_thought: Need ~$190 more to clear p4's $400 blues with houses intact; $240 for Conn $450. $200 covers $400 outright and $450 with one house sale. p1 rejected $300 for buffer; $200+$23 interest leaves them ~$161 plus dark-blue equity. If they refuse, drop to $120 next — even $100 plus selling all 3 houses ($150) survives $450 and keeps pinks unmortgaged. Do not sell TN to p4 (they want me to bust and inherit). Do not build, unmortgage, or sell houses until trades fail. Keep GOOJF and TN orange block.
